PerfectCurse:CurseBloodPower.TITLE: Curse Blood
PerfectCurse:CurseBloodPower.DESCRIPTION: Whenever you draw a Curse, gain #b{Amount} Strength.

PerfectCurse:StarlightAegisPower.TITLE: Starlight Aegis
PerfectCurse:StarlightAegisPower.DESCRIPTION: Whenever you draw a Curse, gain #b{Amount} Block.

PerfectCurse:RideThePoisonPower.TITLE: Ride the Poison
PerfectCurse:RideThePoisonPower.DESCRIPTION: Drawn Curses trigger immediately and are Exhausted, then ALL enemies gain #b{Amount} Poison.

PerfectCurse:MaliciousInfusionPower.TITLE: Malicious Infusion
PerfectCurse:MaliciousInfusionPower.DESCRIPTION: At the start of your next turn, Summon #b{Amount}.
